data.name: Herosbine : The Unknown Island
data.detailed_description:
A Stranger on the Shore

After the unexpected death of his two closest friends, brothers who had become his family, Tim withdrew from the world, carrying grief he never truly faced and questions about who he really is.

When he awakens alone on the shores of the Unknown Island with no memory of how he arrived, he discovers a fractured world shaped by lost friendships, buried truths, and a mysterious force known as Ether.

Explore a World Torn Apart

Journey across the island’s distinct territories, from decaying settlements and hostile swamps to forgotten fortresses and surreal landscapes. Fight dangerous Herosbines, solve environmental puzzles, meet the island’s strange inhabitants, and uncover its story through exploration, conversations, and the traces left behind.

Every territory holds another piece of the island’s past and brings Tim closer to understanding both what happened here and why he was brought to this place.

Claim Their Parts. Shape Your Power.

Every Herosbine is a unique combination of body parts, abilities, and combat styles. Defeat one and one of its parts will drop at random then equip it through Tim’s Etheric Overlay to gain its power while he remains unmistakably himself.

Collect and combine helmets, faces, bodies, and legs to create your own build. Mix Melee, Ranged, and Magic abilities, adapt your loadout to different enemies, and shape a combat style that reflects the way you play.

Master Three Ways to Fight

Switch between Melee, Ranged, and Magic combat styles, each offering a different approach to battle. The parts you equip become most effective when matched with the right combat style, rewarding builds that are designed with purpose.

Specialize in the styles that suit you best, experiment with different combinations, and adjust your loadout as new enemies and challenges demand a different strategy.

Uncover a Broken Legacy

The Unknown Island was once shaped by powerful Heroes whose friendships held its territories together. Now those bonds are broken, each region bears the scars of their conflict, and strange Herosbines roam the land carrying fragments of their power.

Follow the traces they left behind, uncover the truth behind their fall, and discover how Ether transformed both the island and those who once protected it. But the deeper Tim travels, the more the island’s fractured past begins to reflect his own.

Discover 625 Herosbines

Encounter 625 different Herosbine combinations across the Unknown Island, each assembled from the powers and features of its fallen Heroes. Every victory can reward you with a random part from the Herosbine you defeated, expanding the possibilities for your own build.

Each Herosbine also has its own collectible card. Hunt them down, complete your collection, and discover every combination hidden across the island.

Find Your Place

Herosbine is a story-rich journey about grief, friendship, identity, and the struggle to find where you belong. Through cinematic moments, conversations, and discoveries hidden throughout the world, Tim forms new bonds while confronting the pain he has tried to leave behind.

The powers he collects may change the way he fights, but the person he becomes will be shaped by the journey itself.

Key Features

  • Story-rich action-adventure

  • 625 unique Herosbine combinations

  • 625 collectible cards

  • Four interchangeable Hero Part slots

  • Melee, Ranged, and Magic combat

  • Exploration, environmental puzzles, and environmental storytelling

Herosbine: The Unknown Island is an ambitious story-driven action-adventure created by a solo indie developer. It is a deeply personal project built around identity, friendship, exploration, and the freedom to shape the way you play.

Wishlist Now

Wishlist Herosbine: The Unknown Island and follow Tim’s journey into the unknown.

data.short_description: Explore a mysterious open world, battle hundreds of uniquely assembled Herosbines, and claim their Hero Parts to combine their powers and shape your own combat style. Guide Tim through a story-rich journey of grief, identity, and self-discovery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 580 8GB VRAM / GeForce GTX 1060 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: System requirements may change during the development of the game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3800X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 5700-XT / GeForce RTX 2070 / Intel Arc A770 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: System requirements may change during the development of the game.
